rapport_notes: Rep is professional and clear but lacks warmth; conversational tone is transactional and slightly rushed, no personal connection established.
process_discipline_notes: No differentiators repeated; no silence violations detected (customer controlled most pauses).

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Missing entirely. Rep launches into logistics probing with no framing or time-box trade.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked late, after extensive logistics probing: 'Before I discuss the pricing structure here and your estimate, do you have any concern about the moving process?' — asked after pickup/dropoff location, unit details, furniture inventory, and packing services were all covered.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answers 'No' to concerns question; rep accepts with 'Okay, thank you' and pivots immediately to pricing. No follow-up, no dig.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Mentioned in Stage 1 logistics context: 'if it's more than sixty inch we do not have a TV case for that. So we're gonna wrap it with moving blankets' — answered as a direct logistics detail, not as a concern-response differentiator.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: Never mentioned. No reference to 'Meet Your Mover,' named crew lead, or who will show up.
evidence_quotes.communication: Never mentioned. No reference to day-before call, named crew lead, or inbox updates.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor + personalization: 'normally, sir, for a one bedroom apartment, we finish the move-in three and a half hours but in your case we're coming from a second floor and then there's another set of stairs inside your apartment going to a fourth floor apartment with elevator access that's within the apartment complex... I will estimate your move to finish in three hours to four hours... estimated cost is $588 to $784.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_is_a_window: 'But of course, this is only an estimate. If ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time you use.'
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: 'If ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time you use... the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments.'
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: Not asked. Customer asks 'Are you able to email me that quote?' and rep confirms they'll send it and mentions reply deadline for booking. No explicit 'Would you like our help?' or equivalent close from rep.

top_strength: Rep delivered a clear, well-anchored estimate with proper personalization to the customer's specific logistics (two sets of stairs, no drive time), and explained the pricing structure and protections thoroughly with no hidden fees.
coaching_note: Start every call with a quid pro quo framing (time-box + benefit promise), ask the agenda question *before* any logistics probing, and dig two layers deep on any concern raised—don't accept a one-word answer and move on; the customer said 'No' to concerns and you accepted it without exploring what might be on their mind.
